SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, KEY_3 AS REVISION FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRHSDE0003' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N') GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT replace(A.QUOTATION_NO||A.QUOTATION_SEQ,'RE','') AS INTERFACE_HEADER_ID, to_number(A.QUOTATION_SEQ) AS LINE_NUM, A.REVISION AS REVISION, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, 16590 AS CATEGORY_ID, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM FROM KEPRQDT A, ICOMTRXL B, KEPQTDT C WHERE 1=1 AND B.TARGET = A.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.KEY_2 = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = C.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ= C.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = C.REVISION AND C.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.STATUS = 'C' AND B.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND B.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND B.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND B.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND B.KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND B.KEY_10 IN (' ','N') ORDER BY A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N')
